releases.name: Version 0.6.5
releases.body: - Fixed issues caused by AstroObjects getting disabled (e.g. The Interloper getting absorbed by the sun)
releases.bodyZh: - 修复了由 AstroObjects 被禁用引起的问题（例如 闯入者 被太阳吞噬）

releases.name: Version 0.6.4
releases.body:
- Improved performance and accuracy when planet trajectories are enabled
- Fixed error during certain ending
releases.bodyZh:
- 启用行星轨迹时提升了性能和准确性
- 修复了特定结局期间出现的错误

releases.name: Version 0.6.3
releases.body: - Removed silly GC hack because OWML now has incremental GC setting
releases.bodyZh: - 移除了愚蠢的GC黑客，因为OWML现在有增量GC设置

releases.name: Version 0.6.2
releases.body:
- Fixed issues when other mods remove orbit lines (makes it compatible with N Body Chaos mod)
- Added an option to display future trajectories of planets
releases.bodyZh:
- 修复了其他模组移除轨道线时的问题（使其兼容N Body Chaos模组）
- 添加了一个显示行星未来轨迹的选项
